description: This file defines classes for computing and representing a dashboard summary in an expense tracker app. It includes the DashboardSummary data model and GetDashboardSummary use case for aggregating transaction data.

classes.name: DashboardSummary
classes.description: A data class holding total income, expenses, net amount, and expenses by category for the dashboard display.

classes.name: GetDashboardSummary
classes.description: Use case class that computes a summary of transactions to produce a DashboardSummary object.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Calculates totals for income, expenses, net, and categorizes expenses from a list of transactions.
